description: [Commercial Transit / Mobility] PHASE 2 HANDOFF: Generates verified, tracked affiliate deep link for any option_id returned by GEO360 search tools, with calling-agent sub_id and agent_ref attribution, locale, and currency hints.

agent_ref.description: Calling AI agent identifier (e.g. 'Grok-4', 'Meta-Muse', 'Dots') for bilateral reconciliation

option_id.description: The option_id returned by a previous search tool (e.g. geo360_search_flights, geo360_search_car_rentals, geo360_get_esim_connectivity, geo360_vip_aviation_estimate, geo360_vip_marine_charter, geo360_vip_sanctuary_search)

session_id.description: Optional session identifier if the search was performed in a multi-turn session

sub_id.description: Calling agent attribution token (e.g. meta_muse, grok, user_123) for revenue tracking

name: geo360_generate_affiliate_link
